newsitem.title: USA: Flextronics files 2 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: Flextronics files 2 mln share offer.

text.p: Flextronics International Ltd filed a registration statement Thursday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer 2,012,500 ordinary shares.
The number of shares registered includes 262,500 shares to cover over-allotments.

Of the shares being offered, 1,312,500 shares initially are being offered in the United States and Canada by the U.S. underwriters and 437,000 shares are being offered elsewhere by the international managers.
Montgomery Securities is the lead underwriter for the deal.
